change.description:
## Summary Redesigns Troupe's built-in browser chrome, responsive viewport switcher, zoom controls, page annotation & capture workflow, start page, and offline recovery view in a single cohesive update. - **Toolbar & URL bar**: Adds disabled `Back`/`Forward` states, a two-tone borderless sunk URL well (host emphasized, scheme/path muted), a neutral `2px` focus ring (`ring-focus-ring`), Escape/blur revert without surprise navigation, a non-blocking `2px` top loading bar with `Reload ↔ Stop` icon swap, platform-aware shortcut hints (`⌘` on macOS / `Ctrl+` on Linux & Windows), and dev-only `Debug console` gating in production. - **Native per-tab Zoom**: Exposes `browser_tab_set_zoom` (`0.5..=2.0`) via Rust `BrowserTabManager`, top Zoom stepper in `BrowserMoreMenu`, URL-bar zoom pill in Desktop mode when `zoom !== 100%` with presets (`75% / 100% / 125% / 150%`), and `⌘+`/`⌘-`/`⌘0` (`Ctrl+=`/`Ctrl+-`/`Ctrl+0`) shortcuts. - **Responsive Desktop / Tablet / Mobile Switcher**: Adds a `Device` toggle (`desktop → tablet 768×1024 → mobile 390×844 → desktop`), smooth accordion `ResponsiveViewportBar` (`inert` when collapsed), `Rotate` portrait/landscape toggle, inline zoom stepper, centered stage with live left/right drag-resize grips (`320..1280px`), and exact Linux GTK `gtk::Overlay` bounds allocation (`connect_get_child_position`) so native WebViews reflow cleanly at every width and height. - **Merged Page Annotation & Capture**: Replaces the 375KB floating bottom-right Agentation dock with an ~19KB host-controlled Shadow DOM overlay (`src/agentation-toolbar/{entry.tsx, dom-inspect.ts, overlay-styles.ts}` → `src-tauri/resources/agentation-toolbar.js`). Clicking `Annotate` swaps the `40px` URL bar in place into `AnnotationToolbar` (`Done`, `Comment | Rectangle | Ruler`, `Area | Visible`, `Pause`, `Hide pins`, `Copy`, `BatchCommentsPopover`, `Send to chat (N)`), auto-crops annotated elements/rectangles via native `browser_tab_screenshot`, adds persistent red alignment guides & spacing measurements (`Ruler`), exposes `agentation_get_ruler_guides` in the Rust MCP server, and hides the overlay completely on `Done`. - **Start Page & Offline View**: Adds `BrowserStartPage` (omnibox, detected running local dev servers via `browser_list_local_servers`, recent pages, keyboard hints) and `BrowserOfflineView` (`ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`, `Open terminal`, `Retry`, `Back` recovery to previous page, and 2s localhost auto-reload polling via `browser_check_local_port` on IPv4 & IPv6). - **Motion & Tactile Polish**: Adds shared motion tokens and transitions (`src/renderer/styles/browser-transitions.css`) with `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"` and `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` guards, plus tactile polish on `BrowserConsentStrip`, `BrowserConsentCard`, and `browser-tab.tsx`. ## Related Issue No related issue — searched open and closed browser PRs and confirmed no duplicate exists. ## Type of Change - [x] test: adds or updates tests - [ ] build: build or dependency changes - [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes - [ ] chore: maintenance or tooling - [ ] revert: reverts a previous change ## What Changed - `src-tauri/src/browser_automation/{mod.rs, core/mod.rs}`: viewport screenshot capture helper (`capture_tab_screenshot`). - **Overlay (`src/agentation-toolbar/`)**: - `entry.tsx`, `dom-inspect.ts`, `overlay-styles.ts` → rebuilt `src-tauri/resources/agentation-toolbar.js` (19KB). - **Renderer (`src/renderer/`)**: - `components/browser/{BrowserControls, AnnotationToolbar, BrowserMoreMenu, BrowserZoomControl, ResponsiveViewportBar, BrowserStartPage, BrowserOfflineView, BrowserPanel, BrowserConsentStrip}.tsx` + updated unit tests (`BrowserControls.test.tsx`, `BrowserPanel.test.tsx`). - --- ## Summary by cubic Redesigns the built-in browser chrome: the floating annotation dock becomes an integrated toolbar, and the browser gains native per-tab zoom, responsive viewport presets, a start page, and an offline recovery view. **Annotation & capture** - The 375KB floating Agentation dock is replaced by a ~19KB host-controlled Shadow DOM overlay. - Annotate swaps the URL bar for an annotation toolbar (comment, rectangle, ruler, area capture, batch comments, send to chat); Done hides the overlay. - Annotated elements and capture areas are cropped natively via `browser_tab_screenshot`; crop paths persist into the annotation store so MCP can resolve them. - Adds Guide and Measurement annotation kinds with ruler gap spacing and red symmetry guides, exposed via the `agentation_get_ruler_guides` MCP tool. **Toolbar, zoom, viewport, and offline** - Zoom is native per tab (0.5–2.0) with a toolbar stepper, URL-bar pill, and shortcuts; viewport presets (desktop/tablet/mobile) add rotate, inline zoom, and drag-resize grips. - The toolbar adds disabled Back/Forward states, a Reload↔Stop loading bar, URL revert on Escape/blur, and platform-aware shortcut hints. - The start page lists detected local dev servers and recent pages; the offline view adds Retry, Open terminal, back recovery, and 2s localhost auto-reload. - Linux GTK bounds allocation is fixed so WebViews reflow at every viewport width; adds shared motion tokens and reduced-motion support. Written for commit 849bd2ef97f52768f10520aaaf5b89ee26573522. +/**
+ * Lightweight DOM inspection utilities for the host-controlled Troupe browser
+ * annotation overlay. Extracts selectors, React component names, computed
+ * layout styles, and alignment deltas relative to red symmetry guides.
+ */
+
+export interface ElementSummary {
+  element: string
+  elementPath: string
+  fullPath: string
+  cssClasses?: string
+  nearbyText?: string
+  computedStyles?: string
+  reactComponents?: string
+  boundingBox: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }
+}
+
+const RELEVANT_CSS_PROPS = [
+  'display',
+  'position',
+  'width',
+  'height',
+  'padding',
+  'margin',
+  'gap',
+  'font-size',
+  'line-height',
+  'font-weight',
+  'border-radius'
+] as const
+
+export function buildShortLabel(el: Element): string {
+  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase()
+  if (el.id) return `${tag}#${el.id}`
+  const cls =
+    typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean) : []
+  if (cls.length > 0) {
+    return `${tag}.${cls.slice(0, 2).join('.')}`
+  }
+  return tag
+}
+
+export function buildElementPath(el: Element, maxDepth = 4): string {
+  const parts: string[] = []
+  let current: Element | null = el
+  while (current && current !== document.body && parts.length < maxDepth) {
+    parts.unshift(buildShortLabel(current))
+    if (current.id) break
+    current = current.parentElement
+  }
+  return parts.join(' > ') || el.tagName.toLowerCase()
+}
+
+export function extractReactComponents(el: Element): string | undefined {
+  const fiberKey = Object.keys(el).find(
+    (k) => k.startsWith('__reactFiber$') || k.startsWith('__reactInternalInstance$')
+  )
+  if (!fiberKey) return undefined
+  const names: string[] = []
+  let fiber = (el as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[fiberKey] as
+    | { type?: unknown; return?: unknown }
+    | undefined
+  let guard = 0
+  while (fiber && names.length < 5 && guard < 40) {
+    guard += 1
+    const t = fiber.type as { displayName?: string; name?: string } | undefined
+    const name =
+      typeof t === 'function' || (typeof t === 'object' && t !== null)
+        ? t.displayName || t.name
+        : undefined
+    if (name && /^[A-Z]/.test(name) && !names.includes(name)) {
+      names.push(name)
+    }
+    fiber = fiber.return as typeof fiber
+  }
+  return names.length > 0 ? names.join(' < ') : undefined
+}
+
+export function extractComputedSummary(el: Element): string {
+  const cs = window.getComputedStyle(el)
+  const entries: string[] = []
+  for (const prop of RELEVANT_CSS_PROPS) {
+    const val = cs.getPropertyValue(prop)
+    if (val && val !== 'normal' && val !== 'none' && val !== '0px' && val !== 'static') {
+      entries.push(`${prop}: ${val}`)
+    }
+  }
+  return entries.join('; ')
+}
+
+export function inspectElement(el: Element): ElementSummary {
+  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
+  const text = (el.textContent ?? '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 120)
+  const cssClasses =
+    typeof el.className === 'string' && el.className.trim()
+      ? el.className.trim().slice(0, 200)
+      : undefined
+  return {
+    element: buildShortLabel(el),
+    elementPath: buildElementPath(el, 4),
+    fullPath: buildElementPath(el, 10),
+    cssClasses,
+    nearbyText: text || undefined,
+    computedStyles: extractComputedSummary(el) || undefined,
+    reactComponents: extractReactComponents(el),
+    boundingBox: {
+      x: Math.round(rect.x),
+      y: Math.round(rect.y),
+      width: Math.round(rect.width),
+      height: Math.round(rect.height)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export interface GuideAlignmentHit {
+  selector: string
+  elementPath: string
+  deltaPx: number
+  rect: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Find the closest meaningful visible block near a symmetry guide axis that is
+ * misaligned by 1..24px so the overlay can badge its offset delta (e.g. "+8px off").
+ */
+export function findMisalignedNearGuide(
+  axis: 'horizontal' | 'vertical',
+  positionPx: number,
+  hostId: string
+): GuideAlignmentHit | null {
+  const candidates = document.querySelectorAll('main *, header *, section *, form *, article *')
+  let best: GuideAlignmentHit | null = null
+  let bestAbs = 25
+  for (const el of Array.from(candidates).slice(0, 250)) {
+    if (el.id === hostId || el.closest(`#${hostId}`)) continue
+    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
+    if (rect.width < 16 || rect.height < 12) continue
+    const edge = axis === 'vertical' ? rect.left : rect.top
+    const delta = Math.round(edge - positionPx)
+    const abs = Math.abs(delta)
+    if (abs >= 1 && abs < bestAbs) {
+      bestAbs = abs
+      best = {
+        selector: buildShortLabel(el),
+        elementPath: buildElementPath(el, 4),
+        deltaPx: delta,
+        rect: {
+          x: Math.round(rect.x),
+          y: Math.round(rect.y),
+          width: Math.round(rect.width),
+          height: Math.round(rect.height)
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return best
+}

+import type { PendingAnnotationItem } from '@/stores/browser-session-store'
+
+export interface CropRect {
+  x: number
+  y: number
+  width: number
+  height: number
+  dpr?: number
+  /** Page CSS viewport width (`window.innerWidth`) from the injected overlay for zoom-accurate scaling. */
+  viewportWidth?: number
+}
+
+/**
+ * Compute pixel-aligned source crop rectangle for a given image size and rect.
+ * Derives scale from `imgWidth / rect.viewportWidth` when `viewportWidth` is provided
+ * so native WebView zoom and OS DPR are both accounted for accurately.
+ */
+export function computeCropSourceRect(
+  imgWidth: number,
+  imgHeight: number,
+  rect: CropRect
+): { sx: number; sy: number; sw: number; sh: number } {
+  const scale =
+    rect.viewportWidth && rect.viewportWidth > 0
+      ? imgWidth / rect.viewportWidth
+      : rect.dpr && rect.dpr > 0
+        ? rect.dpr
+        : 1
+  const rawX = Math.round(rect.x * scale)
+  const rawY = Math.round(rect.y * scale)
+  const sx = Math.max(0, Math.min(imgWidth - 1, rawX))
+  const sy = Math.max(0, Math.min(imgHeight - 1, rawY))
+  const sw = Math.max(
+    1,
+    Math.min(imgWidth - sx, Math.round(rect.width * scale) + Math.min(0, rawX))
+  )
+  const sh = Math.max(
+    1,
+    Math.min(imgHeight - sy, Math.round(rect.height * scale) + Math.min(0, rawY))
+  )
+  return { sx, sy, sw, sh }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Crop a full-viewport PNG (base64) to a sub-rectangle using an offscreen canvas.
+ * Returns null if decoding fails or Canvas 2D is unavailable so callers never
+ * leak an uncropped full-viewport image in place of a requested area crop.
+ */
+export async function cropBase64Png(
+  base64: string,
+  rect: CropRect
+): Promise<{ base64: string; dataUrl: string } | null> {
+  const dataUrl = `data:image/png;base64,${base64}`
+  if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
+    return null
+  }
+  return new Promise((resolve) => {
+    const img = new Image()
+    img.onload = () => {
+      const { sx, sy, sw, sh } = computeCropSourceRect(img.width, img.height, rect)
+      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
+      canvas.width = sw
+      canvas.height = sh
+      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
+      if (!ctx) {
+        resolve(null)
+        return
+      }
+      ctx.drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, sw, sh)
+      const croppedUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png')
+      const comma = croppedUrl.indexOf(',')
+      if (comma < 0) {
+        resolve(null)
+        return
+      }
+      resolve({
+        base64: croppedUrl.slice(comma + 1),
+        dataUrl: croppedUrl
+      })
+    }
+    img.onerror = () => resolve(null)
+    img.src = dataUrl
+  })
+}
+
+/**
+ * Format pending batch annotations (including ruler guides, measurements, and
+ * persisted crop image paths) into concise, structured markdown ready for chat.
+ */
+export function formatBatchAnnotationsForChat(url: string, items: PendingAnnotationItem[]): string {
+  const lines: string[] = [
+    `Page annotations (${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}) on ${url || 'current page'}:`,
+    ''
+  ]
+  for (const item of items) {
+    const kindTag =
+      item.kind === 'guide'
+        ? `[Guide ${item.axis ?? ''} ${item.positionPx !== undefined ? `${item.positionPx}px` : ''}]`
+        : item.kind === 'measurement'
+          ? item.gapPx !== undefined
+            ? `[Ruler ${item.axis ? `${item.axis} ` : ''}${item.gapPx}px]`
+            : '[Ruler]'
+          : item.kind === 'rectangle'
+            ? '[Area]'
+            : '[Element]'
+    const deltaNote =
+      typeof item.deltaPx === 'number' && item.deltaPx !== 0
+        ? ` (${item.deltaPx > 0 ? `+${item.deltaPx}` : item.deltaPx}px off)`
+        : ''
+    const cropNote = item.cropPath ? ` (crop: \`${item.cropPath}\`)` : ''
+    lines.push(
+      `${item.num}. ${kindTag} \`${item.elementPath || item.element}\`${deltaNote}${cropNote}`
+    )
+    lines.push(`   ${item.comment}`)
+  }
+  return lines.join('\n')
+}
